outcome: Highest quartile of medication exposure (defined as >=30 medications during NICU stay)
Overall number of medications received during NICU admission
cohort: The study included 106 very low birth weight (VLBW) infants admitted to a level-IV neonatal intensive care unit.
finding: VLBW infants are exposed to a large number of medications during NICU hospitalization (median 20, range 4-72), with male sex, lower birth weight, longer length of hospital stay, and the presence of comorbidities like bronchopulmonary dysplasia and necrotizing enterocolitis being associated with higher medication exposure.
